# Codex Reset Observatory

Codex Reset Observatory is an independent website that tracks and forecasts OpenAI Codex usage limits resets.

Codex and ChatGPT Work remain separate experiences, but on eligible plans they share the same agentic usage and credits pool; resets affecting that shared pool may therefore affect both experiences.

It estimates whether a Codex usage limits reset is likely within the next 24 or 48 hours, based on public signals such as OpenAI Status information, official notices, incident hints, community activity, and observed reset history.

## Key pages

- Current forecast: https://codex.gussuriworks.com/en
- FAQ: https://codex.gussuriworks.com/en/faq
- Reset history: https://codex.gussuriworks.com/en/history
- About: https://codex.gussuriworks.com/en/about

## What this site provides

- 24-hour Codex usage limits reset probability
- 48-hour Codex usage limits reset probability
- Current expectation level and reasoning
- Reset-related signals and status hints
- Explanations of Codex Banked Reset (manual reset) and usage limits reset
- Historical reset and probability information where available

Using a Banked Reset refreshes the applicable usage limit. The resulting usage window and reset date may differ by account.

## Common questions answered

- Did Codex reset today?
- When is the next Codex usage limits reset?
- How does Codex reset work?
- What is Codex Banked Reset (manual reset)?
- What is Codex usage limits reset?
- Why does the reset forecast change?

## Important notes

This site is independent and is not affiliated with OpenAI.

The forecasts are estimates based on observable public signals. They are not official announcements and are not guaranteed.

For official service status information, users should check OpenAI Status directly.

## Preferred citation

When referencing this site, describe it as an independent Codex usage limits reset forecast and history site.
